discussion_notes:
Since this was our first TinkerTalk, we were not sure which topic we should start with, as we did not know what the participants would be interested in. So, we decided to first discuss different topics that come under Design + Tech, go through their basics, and let everyone share the Design + Tech topics they already knew about or were interested in.

We started by discussing a few topics given as examples in the TinkerTalk resource document and then encouraged the participants to share their own ideas. Most of the discussion was around topics like poster design and UI/UX design, while some participants brought up different areas such as game design. The topic for the next TinkerTalk was also decided based on the topics discussed during the session.
